answer: Mooring bond: each identity locks 70 and moors to one knoll post on a key-signed quartz receipt. Each epoch the beacon names a post; every identity must re-moor in 10 min with a quartz receipt, auditor checks logs. Sharing a post, reusing a receipt, or missing re-mooring burns bonds; one copied line triggers a ripple audit. K-th mooring costs 36+7(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,532,500 vs 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 36 once, bond back next epoch.
